title.narrative: Support to European Endowment for Democracy (EED) 2024 - IPA

description.narrative: EED supports financially grass-roots and community based organisations, activists and emerging actors. Covering of EED's operating costs is required to help fulfil its mandate of EED. The support takes the form of annual operating grants to be renewed each year. The contract covers the year 2024 from allocation 2022 of the CSF 2021-2023 under IPA III, while combined with funds under NDICI for the Eastern and Southern Neighbourhood.
